records.title: Invoice permission incident
records.contentMarkdown:
I fixed an authorization bug in the invoice endpoint by checking invoice ownership before returning data. I chose a server-side permission check so client-provided identifiers could not bypass authorization. The endpoint previously checked only whether the request was authenticated, which did not establish ownership of the requested invoice.

Verification: I added regression tests for the invoice owner and a different authenticated user. The owner received 200 and the other user received 403. Both tests passed. No numeric business impact or performance improvement was measured.

role: I implemented and verified the ownership check.
